subject: English
passage: Two guilds operating in the same medieval city could establish very different apprenticeship requirements. For instance, one guild might require a four-year apprenticeship; the other guild, ______ might require a ten-year apprenticeship.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. "By contrast" logically signals that the requirement discussed in this part of the sentence—that the other guild might require a ten-year apprenticeship—contrasts with the previously mentioned requirement of one guild having a four-year apprenticeship.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because "for example" illogically signals that the requirement in this part of the sentence is an instance of the same type as the previous requirement. Instead, a ten-year apprenticeship contrasts with a four-year apprenticeship.
